highlights_headline: Head of the 3.119.x servicing line — a WinUI DLL-resolution fix and an Apple TFM backport have landed so far.

bullets.lead: WinUI Projection DLL not found fixed for .NET 9 consumers
bullets.detail: The WinUI3 projection DLL was not being found at runtime under .NET 9, causing startup failures for consumers on the v3 servicing line.

bullets.lead: Backported Apple 26.0 library and unversioned app TFMs
bullets.detail: The Apple TFM corrections from the v4 line (versioned TFMs for libraries, unversioned for apps) have been backported to the v3 servicing line.

contributor_summaries.drasticactions: Backported the Apple 26.0 library and unversioned app TFM fix to the 3.119.x line
